Headline: Brown Line Service Running with Delays
ShortDescription: Brown Line trains are running with reduced frequency due to an earlier incident involving a train at Kimball.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Brown Line trains are running with reduced frequency due to an earlier incident involving a train at Kimball.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#11 Lincoln

#81 Lawrence

#82 Kimball-Homan

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
